body:
The whole race is settled here. One statement: the INSERT wins if no row exists, the DO UPDATE fires only if the stored tenure has expired, and RETURNING is empty when neither happened — so a caller that gets a lease back is the only caller that got one.

`unixepoch()` on both sides is deliberate. Every deadline is set and tested by SQLite, so two executors are never compared against two host clocks.
